result.summary: Found 1 clear visual issue: one restaurant listing has overlapping metadata text, which makes the card look broken and harder to read.

issues.description: In the "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" card, the delivery time and delivery fee text overlap/collide beneath the title, causing the metadata line to render incorrectly.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing and wrapping for the restaurant metadata row so the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine labels sit on separate or properly spaced elements without overlap.
